question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS month_over_month_diff,
        ABS(monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month)) AS abs_diff
    FROM monthly_payments
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
    CAST(payment_month AS VARCHAR) LIKE '____-__-01%' AS check_format,
    substr(CAST(payment_month AS VARCHAR), 1, 7) AS month,
    ROUND(month_over_month_diff, 2) AS max_month_over_month_diff
FROM with_diff w
INNER JOIN customer c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE w.month_over_month_diff IS NOT NULL
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY abs_diff DESC) = 1
